implementation: Independently written compact T8 contract for general cloud/local LLMs; not a verbatim official prompt or a dedicated PE runtime.
differences: Optional advanced profile; Classic and text-to-image remain unchanged.
Fixed UI ratio has priority; ratio_follow is resolved from original image dimensions into the existing ratio port.
Single-image canonical tags are accepted, and explicitly unused multi-image sources generate warnings.
No official PE weights, model loader, inference bridge, canvas, sampler, or automatic remote prompt updates.
rights_note: Upstream materials retain their original terms. T8 authorship does not relicense upstream prompts or weights; a dedicated PE deployment must independently review its applicable terms.
